title: Market report: The wizards of Austria
summary: From a distance, Austria’s live music scene appears to be firing on all cylinders. Seiler & Speer became the first homegrown band to sell out Vienna’s Ernst Happel Stadium, drawing around 50,000 fans to the country’s biggest venue in 2025. It was a landmark moment for a market where stadium andarena business remains at record levels. “Business is constant and stable, which is a good sign in these times,” says Richard Hörmann, co-MD of leading promoter Barracuda Music. title: Trio of Dutch festivals fear new entertainment tax will ‘drive events out’
summary: A local authority in the Netherlands approved an entertainment tax for three major festivals this week, which one organiser says will drive “culture and events out of the municipality”. title: Stadium attendance jump drives Live Nation to $10bn Q3 revenue
summary: Stadium concerts accounted for more than half of Live Nation’s global audience growth in the third quarter, as a later North American touring season and continued international expansion helped drive record attendance. The company reported Q3 revenue of $10.1bn, up 19% year-on-year, while adjusted operating income rose 14% to $1.18bn. Concert attendance reached 61 million, an increase of 19%, with international audiences growing 29%, and North American attendance up 13%.
